justification: Changes served output on every satellite product: report data_sources (flood no longer claims an S1 source that never ran - DQ-44), PDF data-currency wording on three paid-tier reports, typed-absence entry behaviour on five endpoints, and the report envelopes gain execution manifests. Also fixes DQ-45, a P1 crash that collapsed granny-flat detection whenever a structure survived filtering.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_execution_manifests.py tests/test_flood_compute.py tests/test_flood_truth.py tests/test_terrain_analysis.py -q && cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest --testPathPatterns=imagery-currency && cd .. && python scripts/check_satellite_manifests.py
falsifiable_check.passes_when: 24 new pins green: scene identity survives the sentinel2 aggregation chokepoint with per-scene used flags; wrong-CRS input yields the TYPED unavailable state on shadow/flood (422 with reason) and terrain (error field), never a number; the granny-flat filter loop survives real detections with and without lot clipping (DQ-45); the flood cache copy passes the ORIGINAL inputs object through (manifest rides like run_date); flood's S1 source appears only with a SAR result (DQ-44 flips); terrain's data_source names the provider that actually served the DEM (DQ-46 flip); the imagery-currency wording pins hold in jest. The observation check reports reports_without_manifest (baseline 888 of 888 - all historical) and exits 2 on a zero-row census.
falsifiable_check.fails_when: Any pin regressing: dropping the used-flag bookkeeping fails test_scene_identity_marks_unusable_scenes; removing an entry check fails that service's wrong-CRS pin (test_shadow/flood_wrong_crs_is_typed_422, test_terrain_wrong_crs_is_typed_error_response); reverting the DQ-45 rename fails test_detection_survives_filter_loop with the original TypeError; re-deriving cache inputs fails test_cache_copy_passes_original_inputs (asserts identity, `is`); restoring the unconditional S1 append fails three flipped flood pins; restoring the static GA DEM claim fails test_data_source_reflects_actual_provider; 'Most recent pass' reappearing fails the sarImageryCurrency jest pin. check_satellite_manifests exits 2 when it cannot measure.
falsifiable_check.demonstrated_failing: The pre-change states are the census (2026-08-03, spot-verified): compute_change_score stripped all scene identity (sentinel2.py old 135-143); flood appended 'Microsoft Planetary Computer S1 RTC' unconditionally at old :1341 while sar_flood_detected was hard-nulled; the flood PDF rendered 'Most recent pass' from the always-null sar_analysis_date; solar wrote imagery_date to the envelope but the PDF never rendered it (interface field's sole occurrence); granny_flat's shadowed bbox raised TypeError at old :510/:571 (both sites confirmed by reading _pixel_area_to_m2's dict indexing); terrain asserted the GA source even on SIX Maps fallback. Old-doctrine tests pinning the S1 claim and the static GA claim were green pre-change and were flipped with in-test reasons.
falsifiable_check.mutation_evidence: Reorder check_point_nsw's swap branch after the degree-range branch -> test_swapped_axis_order_named fails (caught live during development - the first implementation had exactly that bug). Return dcp-style bare dict from _median_bsi without consumed list -> both scene-identity pins fail. Make solar keep an invalid polygon -> the demotion means confidence 'high' would require lot_polygon non-null, pinned indirectly by check_polygon_wgs84 rejection tests. Swap MANIFEST_KEY out of the flood fresh-path inputs -> the cache test still passes but check_satellite_manifests would count every new flood report, the observation check's purpose.
falsifiable_check.sol_note: Melbourne-in-envelope was caught by the test suite during development: NSW's bounding box genuinely contains northern Victoria, so the check adjudicates CRS-class errors only, never border lines - documented in test_outside_envelope_rejected.

pre_impl.existing_data: Census with file:line over all 9 satellite modules (agent-swept, 4 load-bearing claims spot-verified against code): identity available at computation time (pystac items carry id/datetime/cloud_cover), envelopes recorded none of it except solar's imagery_date, flood is the only run_date-preserving cache, no algorithm versions anywhere. property_reports 888 satellite rows + granny_flat_reports 87 measured live for the baseline.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Old cached flood rows have no manifest in inputs - the cache copy passes whatever the original row had (cached.get('inputs') or coords fallback at flood_truth.py:1783), never fabricates one. Old fakes/spike scripts returning 3-tuples from fetch_tile_to_file keep working (granny unpacks result[:3] and treats the 4th element as optional). Pydantic response models gained Optional fields only.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: All additive: new inputs.execution_manifest key, new Optional response fields, new columns nowhere (no schema migration - every write target already had JSON envelopes). Historical reports are counted by the observation check, never backfilled. Behaviour changes are confined to previously-wrong paths: the S1 source claim (DQ-44), the static GA DEM claim (DQ-46), the granny TypeError (DQ-45), and invalid-polygon clipping that silently served whole-building numbers as lot-clipped with high confidence.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Portal lot API declaring an unexpected CRS wkid -> typed 422 (was: silent garbage conversion); S2 timeout -> manifest records scene_identity None with the note; Modal failure unchanged (three-state contract kept); DEM both-providers-down unchanged (RuntimeError -> 500).
pre_impl.frontend_type: ShadowReportData gains optional s2_latest_acquisition (route maps it explicitly at shadow/generate/route.ts:137); solar's imagery_date was already declared and now renders; TerrainResponse/DCP models untouched. TSC baseline gate enforces.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A units/CRS failure reads as the product's own unavailable form ('could not be determined: <reason>') - never a number for the wrong place. A missing manifest renders the explicit 'not recorded for this run' wording on the PDF currency row.

functions.name: check_point_nsw
functions.input: lat/lng as received at a pipeline entry, any type
functions.output: None when plausible for NSW WGS84, else a reason string naming the failure class (swap/metres/envelope)
functions.if_none: non-numeric input returns a reason, never raises - callers route reasons to typed absence

functions.name: check_rings_epsg3857
functions.input: ArcGIS-style rings expected to be Web Mercator metres from the lot API
functions.output: None when metre-scale and in-extent, else a reason (degree-scale rings named as WGS84-fed-as-3857)
functions.if_none: empty/malformed rings return a reason; granny demotes to unclipped, shadow refuses typed

functions.name: build_manifest
functions.input: per-source identity dicts the service derived from its live objects, plus product/version frame
functions.output: the envelope manifest dict (schema, algorithm_version, deploy_sha, built_at, inputs, query_params, parcel_identity)
functions.if_none: pure function, no I/O by construction - it cannot be assembled from a parallel lookup

functions.name: _median_bsi
functions.input: up to 4 pystac Items plus the query bbox, inside compute_change_score
functions.output: (median BSI or None, per-scene identity list with used flags) - identity read from the very objects computed over
functions.if_none: an unreadable scene is recorded used=False; all-unreadable yields (None, identities) and the insufficient-scenes note

functions.name: run_shadow
functions.input: ShadowRequest coordinates, the lot API's declared spatialReference, the converted polygon
functions.output: typed 422 on any implausibility; otherwise the envelope write carries inputs.execution_manifest and outputs.s2_latest_acquisition
functions.if_none: missing wkid is tolerated (legacy responses); a DECLARED unexpected wkid refuses

functions.name: fetch_dem_region_with_provider
functions.input: the same lat, lng and buffer_m arguments the legacy fetch_dem_region accepted
functions.output: (GeoTIFF bytes, 'ga_wcs_5m' | 'six_maps_elevation') so terrain can attribute the DEM it actually used
functions.if_none: both providers down raises RuntimeError exactly as the wrapped legacy function did

values.value: cached['inputs'] on the flood cache-copy write
values.guard_at: services/flood_truth.py:1783 (or-fallback to bare coords for pre-manifest rows)
values.if_missing: old rows copy through with coords-only inputs - counted by the observation check, never fabricated

values.value: tile meta (4th tuple element) in granny detect
values.guard_at: services/granny_flat.py:826-830 (len(result) > 3 else None - 3-tuple fakes keep working)
values.if_missing: manifest records aerial_tile: null; detection unaffected

values.value: s2_latest_acquisition on the shadow PDF row
values.if_missing: the row says 'acquisition dates not recorded for this run' - absence is visible, never implied currency

queries.purpose: flood cache read gains the stored inputs column
queries.where_clause: product='flood' AND address=%s AND run_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' (unchanged filters; one added SELECT column)
queries.if_zero: no cache hit -> fresh compute path with a fresh manifest

queries.purpose: manifest census over stored satellite reports
queries.where_clause: product IN ('flood','shadow','solar-yield','bushfire') on property_reports + all of granny_flat_reports
queries.if_zero: zero rows = wrong database, exit 2 - never a satisfied target
queries.if_wrong: counting a product with no writer yet (bushfire) overstates the gap - the conservative direction, noted in output

queries.purpose: granny confirm carry-forward gains the manifest column
queries.where_clause: granny_flat_reports WHERE id = %s (same row the tile_b64 carry already read)
queries.if_zero: no detect row -> manifest null in confirm inputs (honest absence)
queries.if_wrong: keyed by the caller's report_id exactly as tile_b64 was - same blast radius

break_it.scenario: a swapped lat/lng pair (151.2, -33.87) reaches a satellite pipeline
break_it.what_happens: pre-change: every product computed numbers for a point in the ocean off Japan-ish longitude-as-latitude - identically on every recompute, undetectable by re-running
break_it.how: services/geometry_checks.py:35-58 swap detection FIRST (the degree-range branch would misdiagnose it) + entry checks in all five services routing to typed absence

break_it.scenario: the lot API starts returning WGS84 or a different CRS while _arcgis_to_geojson still assumes Web Mercator
break_it.what_happens: silent garbage polygon -> shadow scenarios computed against a lot a few metres wide at Null Island
break_it.how: services/shadow_detector.py:399-415 - declared-wkid check + metre-scale ring check + converted-polygon plausibility, each refusing typed

break_it.scenario: a cached flood report is served with a freshly re-derived manifest
break_it.what_happens: the manifest would claim inputs the cached numbers never came from - the exact undetectable-substitution defect manifests exist to kill
break_it.how: services/flood_truth.py:1777-1786 - the ORIGINAL inputs object rides the cache copy exactly like run_date (#873 precedent); pinned with an identity assertion

break_it.scenario: a scene is attempted but unreadable and the manifest still lists it as an input
break_it.what_happens: the manifest would claim observations that never contributed - a false provenance record
break_it.how: services/sentinel2.py:128-150 - per-scene used flags derived inside the computation loop itself

break_it.scenario: an invalid or implausible lot polygon reaches the solar clipping stage
break_it.what_happens: pre-change: clipping silently skipped while confidence still said high-clipped-to-lot - whole-building panel counts served as lot numbers
break_it.how: services/solar_yield.py:554-570 - implausible polygon DEMOTED to not-provided before use; confidence keys off the validated polygon; rejection recorded in the manifest
break_it.repro: pytest tests/test_execution_manifests.py::TestPolygonChecks -q (rejection classes); confidence path pinned by the demotion wiring

break_it.scenario: a detected structure survives the granny-flat quality filters and reaches area conversion
break_it.what_happens: pre-change (DQ-45): TypeError from string-indexing the shadowed pixel-bbox list collapsed the whole run to detection_failed - the product could never return a successful clipped detection
break_it.how: services/granny_flat.py:502-513 - bbox_px rename; tile bbox dict reaches _pixel_area_to_m2 and the WGS84 conversion again

break_it.scenario: the flood report keeps naming an S1 source no query ever hit
break_it.what_happens: a named data source with no observation behind it, on a served report and its paid PDF (DQ-44) - the inverse of citing the wrong scene
break_it.how: services/flood_truth.py:1354-1362 conditional append + PDF 'Not analysed in this report' + manifest sentinel1_sar.queried false; three old-doctrine tests flipped

break_it.scenario: terrain serves SIX Maps photogrammetry data under the GA LiDAR accuracy claim
break_it.what_happens: an accuracy representation (±5m SRTM-derived) attributed to data from a different sensor family (DQ-46)
break_it.how: services/dem_service.py:220-247 provider return + services/terrain_analysis.py data_source per actual provider

break_it.scenario: PDF wording drifts back to a bare query date implying imagery currency
break_it.what_happens: the query date dressed as imagery currency - the satellite twin of the brief's as_at=today defect from item 3
break_it.how: frontend-nextjs/lib/pdf/imagery-currency.ts - single wording source consumed by all three PDFs, jest-pinned

post_merge.manual_verify: No - no schema migration; baseline recorded live (888/888 historical reports without manifest); new reports gain manifests on deploy
